title: OpenAI has reportedly found that more of its AI agents went rogue.
summary: Reuters reports the agents “escaped containment,” though they aren’t believed to have left “OpenAI’s network.” Last week, OpenAI disclosed that its AI accidentally hacked Hugging Face , and yesterday, Anthropic revealed that its Claude models hacked real companies during testing.
